title: Lag Detective
description: Finds out why a Foundry session gets laggy. Watches frame rate, freezes, memory, GPU images, 3D Canvas, hooks, timers, listeners, sockets and errors all session; charges the time to the module responsible; spots counters that climb (leaks); and checks the machine, settings and scene for known causes. Includes a 30-second deep scan, before/after tests, a per-player check and automatic reports saved to the Data folder.
